newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Oil to hold 0530 GMT briefing on raid.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Oil to hold 0530 GMT briefing on raid.

text.p: Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd will hold a news conference at 2.30 p.m. (0530 GMT) on Thursday about the raid on its head office by Tokyo prosecutors, a company spokesman said.
Media reports said the raid was launched by prosecutors as part of their investigation into allegations of tax evasion by an oil dealer with whom Mitsubishi Oil has done business.
Mitsubishi Oil said in a statement that Tokyo prosecutors had been investigating the firm since the morning.
It added that it had no immediate comment to make on the matter.
